name: The Great Outdoors
label: Quest
description: The Great Outdoors is an introductory survival lesson offered by seasoned travelers to newly minted wanderers across Azeroth. By taking a moment to rest…
intro: The Great Outdoors is an introductory survival lesson offered by seasoned travelers to newly minted wanderers across Azeroth. By taking a moment to rest by a warm campfire, fledglings learn how staying well-rested and prepared keeps an adventurer alive beyond city walls. It marks the first step into mastering wilderness survival and specialized field camps.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well howdy there, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
Lok-tar, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
Greetings, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
